svg.title: Account and permission boundary
svg.desc: A file opens for one account but not another. Check who is signed in; note “standard user”. Do not switch accounts or change permissions. An “Access denied” message is evidence of a boundary, not permission to bypass it.
svg.text: A file opens for one account but not another.

g.text: Check who is signed in; note “standard user”.
Record the error without exposing full names.
Do not switch accounts or change permissions.
Ask the owner or mentor for authorized access.

svg.text: An “Access denied” message is evidence of a boundary, not permission to bypass it.
